# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 6 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_006_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 6

**6:1** And the child grew strong day by day. When she was six months old, her mother set her on the ground to test whether she could stand, and she walked seven steps and came to her mother's bosom. And her mother caught her up, saying, "As the Lord my God lives, you shall walk no more on this ground until I bring you into the temple of the Lord."

**6:2** And she made a sanctuary in her bedchamber, and she suffered nothing common or unclean to pass through it. And she called to the undefiled daughters of the Hebrews and they played with her.

**6:3** And when the child had her first birthday, Joachim made a great feast and invited the priests and the scribes and the elders and all the people of Israel. And Joachim brought the child to the priests, and they blessed her, saying, "O God of our fathers, bless this child and give her an everlasting name to be named in all generations." And all the people said, "So be it, amen."

**6:4** And he brought her to the chief priests, and they blessed her, saying, "O God on high, look upon this child and bless her with an ultimate blessing which cannot be surpassed."

**6:5** And her mother carried her up into the sanctuary of her bedchamber and gave her suck. And Anna made a song to the Lord God, saying, "I will sing a holy song to the Lord my God, because he has visited me and has taken away from me the reproach of my enemies. And the Lord God has given to me the fruit of his righteousness, single and manifold before him. Who shall tell the sons of Reuben that Anna gives suck? Hear, hear, O twelve tribes of Israel: Anna gives suck."

**6:6** And she laid the child to rest in the sanctuary of her bedchamber and went out and ministered to them. When the feast was completed they went away rejoicing and glorifying the God of Israel.
